issues.legal_issue: A family’s size for eligibility for an enlarged agricultural land ceiling is determined by counting its members as a whole, while the specified-category requirement is a separate condition.
material_facts: The landholder’s family included the landholder, spouse, three minor sons, and three minor daughters; it therefore had more than five members even without counting the landholder’s mother.
The family included three minor sons, who belonged to a specified category.
The tribunal treated the landholder, spouse, and minor sons as the only members relevant to the size test, resulting in a count of five.
issues.conclusion: The family satisfied both conditions for eligibility: it had more than five members and included members of a specified category. Members outside the specified categories could not be excluded when determining the family’s size.
issues.legal_principle: Section 6(3B) of the Gujarat Agricultural Land Ceiling Act, 1960 requires cumulatively that the family consist of more than five members and that it include members belonging to one or more of the specified categories. Since the Act does not define “family,” the expression takes its commonly understood meaning, including parents and offspring living together in one household. The Court approved the interpretation in Nathekhan v. Mamlatdar, Vadgam, which held that there was no basis for excluding a wife, widowed mother, or unmarried daughters from the family when counting its members.

predicates.agricultural_land_ceiling_claim: A landholder seeks relief in a proceeding concerning the ceiling on agricultural land holdings.
predicates.family_members_exceed_five: The landholder’s family, counted as a whole under the commonly understood meaning of family, has more than five members.
predicates.family_includes_qualifying_member: The family includes at least one member belonging to a specified category.

issues.definition: When a landholder seeks agricultural land ceiling relief, the family meets the eligibility conditions if its members counted as a whole exceed five and it includes a member of a specified category.

issues.legal_issue: The additional ceiling allowed to an eligible family is calculated by counting its members belonging to the specified categories, with the total permissible holding capped at twice the ordinary ceiling.
material_facts: The family included three minor sons belonging to a specified category.
The ordinary ceiling was 45 acres, and the family held 60 acres and 4 gunthas.
Applying one-fifth of the ordinary ceiling for each of the three qualifying members yielded an additional 27 acres and a total permissible holding of 72 acres.
issues.conclusion: The additional ceiling is one-fifth of the ordinary ceiling for each member belonging to a specified category, subject to the family’s total holding not exceeding twice the ordinary ceiling. On the facts, the family’s holding did not exceed the permissible ceiling.
issues.legal_principle: Section 6(3B) of the Gujarat Agricultural Land Ceiling Act, 1960 provides an additional allowance of one-fifth of the ceiling area for each member in excess of five, subject to a maximum total holding of twice the ceiling area. The Court held that “each member” for this computation means each member belonging to a specified category. The Court relied on the formula stated in Nathekhan v. Mamlatdar, Vadgam.

predicates.agricultural_land_ceiling_claim: A landholder seeks relief in a proceeding concerning the ceiling on agricultural land holdings.
predicates.family_members_exceed_five: The landholder’s family, counted as a whole under the commonly understood meaning of family, has more than five members.
predicates.family_includes_qualifying_members: The family includes members belonging to one or more specified categories, whose number determines the additional ceiling allowance.

issues.definition: For an eligible family, the additional ceiling allowance is calculated by reference to the number of its members belonging to specified categories, subject to a maximum total holding of twice the ordinary ceiling.
